# KaTeX browser assets

Version: 0.16.11
Source: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/releases/tag/v0.16.11
Release archive: `katex.tar.gz`
Archive SHA-256: `b968d389d7b9455e191605e4984c52faf3123213271880b02abc45e6ad4bbf43`
License: MIT; see `LICENSE`.

The vendored subset contains the minified browser JavaScript, CSS, and referenced
fonts. The application loads these locally, without a runtime CDN or npm build.
Repository text is escaped. KaTeX is configured with `trust: false`, strict
rendering, and expansion/size limits.
